full_judgment: 4. The case of the writ petitioners, in short, was that they were freedom fighters and journalists by profession. That the lands of Plot Nos. 1501, 1502, 1525, 1527, 1528, 1529, 1530 and 1531 of mouza East Laksminarayanpur of Noakhali Sadar, Noakhali were acquired in L.A. Case No. 2 of 1920 for Public Works Directorate, Noakhali. That the writ petitioners by taking temporary lease of this land from the Public Works Authority, Noakhali started to live thereon by constructing their dwelling houses thereon since 1985. That the writ petitioners filled up the ditch land and developed that at their own cost with their legitimate expectation that they would be given permanent settlement of the said land. The writ petitioners applied for permanent lease of the said land to the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali and the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali, for the purpose of giving permanent lease of the said land to the writ petitioners, took back the said land in the khas khatian No. 1 of the government by the gazette notification dated 19.09.1996. That the writ petitioners thereafter were given lease of the said land on yearly basis and they had been possessing the said land as before. That on 12.042000 the writ petitioners submitted an application to the former State Minister, Land for giving permanent lease of the said land to them and the Hon able State Minister for land, after receiving that application, directed the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali for taking necessary steps. That on 28.05.2001 the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali sent a letter to the Secretary; Ministry of Land recommending for giving permanent lease of the said land to the writ petitioners. On receipt  of the said memo of the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali the respondent No. 2 by his memo dated 20.06.2001 requested the Deputy Commissioner to supply the name and address of the writ petitioners with the verification as to whether they were genuine freedom fighters and also to send the proposal for giving permanent lease to the writ petitioners. The Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali then by his memo dated 13.07.2001 again sent his recommendation for giving permanent lease of the said land to the writ petitioners. That thus the proposal for giving permanent lease of the said land to the writ petitioners was under process and at that stage the dwelling houses of the writ petitioners on the said land were demolished by the local administration without giving any notice to the writ petitioners. The writ petitioners thus have been compelled to file this writ petition.
